title: Encode and Decode Strings
description:
Design an algorithm to encode a list of strings to a string. The encoded string is then sent over the network and is decoded back to the original list of strings.

Please implement `encode` and `decode`.
constraints: strs[i] contains any possible characters among 256 valid ASCII characters.
hints: Delimiters alone will fail if strings contain that delimiter (e.g. comma, colon, newline).
Prefix each string with its length and a separator: [length] + "#" + [string].
When decoding, read digits until "#" to know exactly how many characters to slice.
